text:
A boy and a girl run up a hill in the same time.
boy weighs 600N
girl weighs 500N
The boy weighs more than the girl.
Which statement is true about the power produced?
A
The boy produces more power.
B
The girl produces more power.
C
They both produce the same power.
D
It is impossible to tell who produces more power.

options.label: C
options.text: They both produce the same power.

options.label: D
options.text: It is impossible to tell who produces more power.
